department: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by January 15 for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering: January 15th

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for any department graduate program.
gre_general.quote: The GRE exam is not required for any MIE graduate program application.

fee_waiver.value: Only active-duty or veteran military applicants get a fee waiver; the department says there are no others.
fee_waiver.quote: Active duty or veteran military personnel are eligible for application fee waivers. | Otherwise, there are no application fee waivers.

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor to apply, but you need one before starting to be funded.
supervisor.quote: You do not need a supervisor before applying, but you would eventually need a supervisor before starting the program to be funded.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; bachelor's holders enter the PhD through an MS/PhD path.
entry_route.quote: To apply to the PhD program, a Master's degree is not required.

also.quote: A master’s degree is not required to apply to a PhD program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Industrial Engineering and Operations Research is a separate PhD in the same department.
